args.summary: The weekly branch snapshot branches_20261019.csv arrived late (2026-10-20 09:40). The ingest_branches run for ds 2026-10-19 had already finished at 06:02, so it found no new snapshot. Because of that, dim_branch did not include BR-035 Marlow Sound, which opened on 2026-10-21 as announced. The two loans opened there that day failed the relationships test and showed up as UNMAPPED in mart_delinquency. The file is complete and correct now. As the contract says to do for a late snapshot, I re-ran ingest_branches for 2026-10-19, which also rebuilt and republished that day's partition. I then re-ran dbt_build for 2026-10-21 so the mart and publish picked up the branch. dim_branch now has 35 branches, the mart has no UNMAPPED rows, the test passes and the alert has cleared. Code and monitors needed no changes.
